title: You have a second brain in your gut with 500 million neurons
voiceover: You have a second brain. It's in your gut, and it has over five hundred million neurons. Scientists call it the enteric nervous system, and it can operate completely on its own, without any signal from your actual brain. It controls digestion, but it also makes ninety percent of your body's serotonin... the chemical that controls your mood. So when you get a gut feeling? That's not a metaphor. That's literally a second brain talking to you. The next time your stomach feels off before a big decision... it might know something you don't. Follow for one mind-blowing fact a day.
